annotations.title: Read docs around a search hit

description:
Opens any part of the docs (a section or a whole page) as markdown, with links to move around it. Use it on a search_docs hit before answering from it: a hit is one chunk, and often a fragment (a table row without the header that says which column is which plan, one step of a procedure). Pass the hit's chunk_id to get the whole section it is in.

Every result is a node in the page's outline. parent_id goes one level up (to the enclosing section, then the page); children lists the sections one level down; previous_id / next_id move to the neighbouring sections. Pass any of those ids back in. It also takes a docs URL, e.g. a link in the text; a #fragment opens that section. Text over 20,000 characters (a whole Postgres reference page, a long page) comes back in parts: you get the part holding the chunk you passed, and part / part_count say which.

id.description: Any docs id: a chunk_id or section_id from search_docs, a page_id, or a parent_id / children id from an earlier get_context. A chunk_id returns the section the chunk is in. Give this or url.

part.description: Which part of the text to return when part_count > 1. Defaults to the part holding the chunk you passed, else part 1.

url.description: A docs URL (tigerdata.com/docs, postgresql.org/docs, postgis.net/docs), e.g. a link found in docs text. With a #fragment it returns that section, otherwise the page. Give this or id.

name: get_context

children.description: The sections one level down, in order. Their text is already in `text`; open one by id to read just that part.

characters.description: Length of its text, including its own children.

heading.description: Its heading path below this node, e.g. "4.1. Spatial Data Model > 4.1.1. OGC Geometry" when the level between has no text of its own.

headings.description: Heading path of this node, outermost first. Empty for a page.

id.description: This node: a section_id, or the page_id.

next_id.description: The next section at the same level, under the same parent.

parent_id.description: The node one level up (the enclosing section, or the page). Null for a page.

part_count.description: Above 1, call again with `part` for the rest.

previous_id.description: The previous section at the same level, under the same parent.

text.description: The node as markdown with everything nested under it, led by its parent headings. When part_count > 1 this is one part.

url.description: Link to this node on the docs site.

version.description: Docs version, for versioned sources (Postgres, PostGIS).

title: Read docs around a search hit
